name: thryx
description: Thryx project management over MCP: issues, projects, cycles, milestones, and documents in your Thryx workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Read and update issues, projects, cycles, and documents in Thryx
interface.longDescription: Connects to a Thryx workspace over MCP so an agent can search and triage issues, plan cycles, track milestones, and read or write project documents. Calls that are hard to undo are refused until the caller passes an explicit confirmation flag on that same request — a deliberate speed bump against careless automation, not a permission boundary.
defaultPrompt: What is the status of my current cycle?
Triage the untriaged issues in this project
Draft a milestone plan from these tickets
